reason: A dsh Web UI plugin that monitors OpenCode Go quota windows, reset times, and refresh status using an external API.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh Web UI 中显示 OpenCode Go 的滚动、每周和每月额度使用情况及重置时间，并支持手动和定时刷新。
summaries.en: Displays OpenCode Go rolling, weekly, and monthly quota usage with reset times in the dsh Web UI, with manual and scheduled refreshes.

capabilities: Reads OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY through the credentials service
Fetches OpenCode Go quota data from an external API
Displays rolling, weekly, and monthly quota usage and reset times in the dsh Web UI
Refreshes quota data manually and every five minutes
